questions.prompt: What do the friends find after Burrow opens the old door?
choices: A round room covered in glowing drawings.
A tunnel filled with buried treasure.
A cave where the Crystal Stream begins.
questions.answer: A round room covered in glowing drawings.
questions.evidenceText: Inside was a small round room. The walls were covered in tiny glowing drawings.

questions.prompt: Why is Luna able to name the room after entering it?
choices: She remembers the Memory Room from long ago.
She reads its name on Burrow's new map.
She hears the creatures inside call its name.
questions.answer: She remembers the Memory Room from long ago.
questions.rationale: Before entering, Luna says she knows the door from a very long time ago; inside, she names the Memory Room and says, "I remember now," showing she remembers the Memory Room from long ago.
questions.evidenceText: The memory room, said Luna. That is what it was called. She touched the wall very gently. I remember now.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Luna looked at it for a long time. I know this door, she said slowly. I think. A very long time ago.

questions.prompt: What does Burrow add by drawing the Hollow Oak on the blank wall?
choices: Their own story becomes part of Moonwood's memory.
The drawing marks the quickest tunnel back to the Oak.
The blank wall replaces the stories Luna had forgotten.
questions.answer: Their own story becomes part of Moonwood's memory.
questions.rationale: The room's walls hold drawings of every living thing that has been in Moonwood; when Burrow draws the Hollow Oak and says, "Now we are in it too," this shows their own story becomes part of Moonwood's memory.
questions.evidenceText: Very carefully, he drew the Hollow Oak. Now we are in it too, he said.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: The walls were covered in tiny glowing drawings. Trees and streams. Creatures and old paths. Every living thing that had ever been in Moonwood.
